title: OpenTelemetry Collector：敏感欄位移除與觀測保留
titleEn: OpenTelemetry Collector: redaction while retaining observability
subcategoryTitle: 偵測品質、事件分析與鑑識
subcategoryTitleEn: Detection quality, incident analysis and forensics
summary: 畫出receiver、processor、exporter的資料路徑，確認所有輸出分支都經過必要遮罩或刪除。
summaryEn: Map receiver, processor and exporter paths, confirming every output branch passes required redaction or deletion.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Telemetry branch contract and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
只在主要exporter前刪除欄位，另一debug分支仍可能外送；雜湊識別資料也不一定不可重新識別。
對照「遙測分支契約」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。優先不收集不必要欄位，對其餘做明確允許清單；不得將實際個資送入本課或外部翻譯。
本階段必須重驗：畫出receiver、processor、exporter的資料路徑，確認所有輸出分支都經過必要遮罩或刪除。
steps.instructionEn:
Redaction only before the primary exporter can leave a debug branch exposed; hashed identifiers may remain re-identifiable.
Against the nominal Telemetry branch contract result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Prefer not collecting unnecessary fields and allowlist the rest; do not submit real personal data to this course or external translation.
Reverify this criterion: Map receiver, processor and exporter paths, confirming every output branch passes required redaction or deletion.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。只在主要exporter前刪除欄位，另一debug分支仍可能外送；雜湊識別資料也不一定不可重新識別。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Redaction only before the primary exporter can leave a debug branch exposed; hashed identifiers may remain re-identifiable.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.instruction:
交付資料流、200欄位測試、所有輸出差異及必要觀測欄位保留證據。
在交接件中加入「遙測分支契約」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：畫出receiver、processor、exporter的資料路徑，確認所有輸出分支都經過必要遮罩或刪除。

Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Map receiver, processor and exporter paths, confirming every output branch passes required redaction or deletion. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
